notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
Bugfixes:
[list]
[*]Galleries now work as intended. The fix is applied automatically before entering the main menu.
[*]Diana is revealed automatically if you visited Amber in any playthrough. The fix is applied at the same phase as the gallery fix.
[*]The skip transitions button in the settings is now shown properly.
[/list]

Happy New Year!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Another go to fix rare "Arguments supplied, but parameter list not present" errors. 

We tried to keep those saves playable by providing a set of instructions what to do if the save was made right after a scene belonging to a gallery item had ended.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content: Bugfix for the error appearing after a save was loaded.

notes.title: Alternate Existence Season 1 - release date
notes.content:
Good day Everyone. 

Exciting news regarding Alternate Existence and it's release date. It has now been set for 27 November 2023. Make sure to wish list it if you have not and tell your friends.

Alternate Existence is about you playing as MC who start off life as a 6h00 to 20h00 stiff. Then one day it all changes. Things become easier but along with the new set of freedom, secrets are revealed. New enemies emerge. 

Luckily, shrouded in all of this mystery you get to meet incredibly women. Beautiful women who are seeking your attention. Friends, you forgotten you had. Discover secret powers and things about your life that will alter your perception of what your life has been up to now.

Learn how to defend yourself against the onslaught of the university bullies. Learn to love again. Date a girl and call her your girlfriend. Enjoy the advances of the sexy Dean of the university just because you can.

All of this packaged into one Season and with Season 2 in production, why skip this Visual Novel?

Misterknobb
